prompt: Create a photorealistic sunlit outdoor portrait of a young East Asian woman at a seaside resort, framed as a close-up from the chest up in a square 1:1 composition. She has long flowing dark brown wavy hair tousled by a light breeze, glowing dewy skin, natural makeup, soft peach lips, and a playful expression with one eye winking and a gentle smile while looking directly at the camera. She wears a delicate beige floral lace camisole with thin straps and a small bow at the center, plus exactly 3 visible pearl jewelry pieces: one pearl stud earring, one short pearl necklace, and one longer layered pearl necklace with a small pendant. The background shows a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds, intense sun behind her upper-left hairline creating strong backlight, halo glow, and colorful lens flares, with a blurred ocean coastline, railings, greenery, and distant hills below. Use shallow depth of field, high-end fashion editorial photography, warm summer atmosphere, soft skin highlights, realistic hair flyaways, natural body posture leaning slightly toward the camera, and a dreamy vacation aesthetic. Avoid text, logos, extra people, distorted anatomy, over-smoothed skin, or cartoon styling.
